function_under_test: _rank_recommendation_items [production ranking function, includes hard university+major gate + GPA-gap/amount/openness sort -- NOT the raw fuzzy score, see eval_scholarship_matching.py for that sub-component]
methodology_note: Precision/Recall/F1@K and MRR are computed against gate_eligible_relevant (topically relevant scholarships that also pass the hard university+major gate) -- a topically relevant scholarship for a different university is correctly excluded by design, not a ranking failure. avg_gate_coverage reports what fraction of topically-relevant scholarships the hard gate discards, as a separate diagnostic.
